verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official local CLI (`cubic review`) that runs from the terminal to review uncommitted changes before push, and can connect to Claude Code/ChatGPT subscriptions for local reviews, but this is a review agent rather than a general-purpose coding agent that writes/edits code interactively in the terminal. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive terminal coding-agent loop (code generation/editing, multi-turn task execution) beyond review-only CLI use.
